cases.name: Dihada, Binder of Wills
cases.text:
[+2]: Up to one target legendary creature gains vigilance, lifelink, and indestructible until your next turn.
[−3]: Reveal the top four cards of your library. Put any number of legendary cards from among them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. Create a Treasure token for each card put into your graveyard this way.
[−10]: Gain control of all noncreature permanents until end of turn. Untap them. They gain haste until end of turn.
Dihada, Binder of Wills can be your commander.

cases.name: Rowan, Fearless Sparkmage
cases.text:
[+1]: Up to one target creature gets +3/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn.
[−2]: Rowan deals 1 damage to each of up to two target creatures. Those creatures can't block this turn.
[−8]: Gain control of all creatures until end of turn. Untap them. They gain flying until end of turn.
